title.rendered: Recording of Board Work Session – January 20, 2021

content.rendered: Last night we experienced technical issues while attempting to live stream our 6:00pm Board Work Session. That meeting was recorded, and can now be viewed at https://youtu.be/HsB-IHZIg44.
